sourcebase.bundle_hash_rule: Parent hashes compact sorted cycle-relative [path,sha256(filebytes)] JSON after adding formal-design files; write hash in later receipt, never recursively inside input bundle

session_policy.stop_predicate: manual_stop_requested true OR STOP_AUTONOMOUS exists in either root
session_policy.stop_checked_by_child: both false/absent when read; parent must reread before dispatch
future_test_gate: existing eligible retained full-five-seed selected-RAM verification

training.none_gradient_rule: skip decay moments counter and parameter update
training.zero_gradient_rule: active ordinary Adam decay moments and counter

loader_rng.tails: use actual B in all coefficients

algorithm.C: source probability BCE mean over 2B entries
algorithm.mu: class mean of source probabilities, differentiable
algorithm.variance: mean((p-mu)^2), population divisor n_a, centered FP32, no detach
algorithm.conceptual_pair_measure: uniform n^2 ordered within-domain pairs including self; same labels use mean of two BCE values; opposite labels oriented positive-first
algorithm.reference_point_match: q_R=q_B=.5 and first score derivatives=(-1,+1) when both scores=.5
algorithm.missing_class: cell mean BCE, no artificial pairs
algorithm.nonfinite_policy: technical PAUSE preserving last valid RAM transaction; no scientific kill
algorithm.clean_reference_gradient_identity: For all p_it=.5, every arm has dL/dp_it=(1-2*y_it)/B for any class proportions; not an all-state match

comparisons.primary_per_dataset: NQR-025 selected fixed_ema minus CLEAN selected fixed_ema
secondary: NQR-025 selected fixed_ema minus CLEAN selected online total difference
NQR-025 selected online minus CLEAN selected online
each mechanism control minus CLEAN fixed_ema

diagnostics.direct_clean_branch: C=A=L plus counts/masses; unobserved class scores/BCE and undefined Q are JSON null, no second forward

runtime.incoming_profile: new full-batch/tail/diagnostic/validation/serialization smoke full-process NVML with torch and context accounting; max with later observations; no double counting
runtime.bootstrap_smoke_reference: C1 full-process evidence and b7 correction only until actual C2 measured profile; not a C2 measurement

storage.launch_owner: original parent persistent foreground exec after review
storage.snapshot_boundary: acknowledged epoch after validation; complete parameter/EMA transaction
storage.recovery: same new-root owner last ACK only; all relevant workers dead; no missing-state reconstruction
storage.epoch0_reinit: only if no ACK state ever existed and failure recorded
storage.complete_retention: selected online/EMA pairs for all30 until parent analysis/review/acceptance

required_gates_before_formal_run: distinct reviewer PASS or PASS WITH FIXES and zero blockers
measured full-process physical fit and CURRENT utilization
required_engineering_checks: literal pair sum value/gradient versus moments
coefficient accounting with absent/singleton/one-class cells and true tails
no probe/RNG and ordinary gate detach
all-three-arm CLEAN probability-gradient identity at p=.5 for arbitrary class proportions
